name: Sea fastening and transport restraints
description: Temporary welded or bolted restraints hold modules, jackets and equipment to a transport barge or heavy-lift vessel. They are designed for the transport load case and removed offshore.

gaps.what: Sea-fastening load case and allowable bearing pressure
gaps.why: No page read gives the transport load case or the allowable grillage bearing pressure.
gaps.next_action: Fetch a transport procedure or DNV-ST-N001 and record the load case and bearing pressure

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
